fix_assessment.rationale: PR 48481 directly guarded the legacy MainWindow SetWindowPosition race evidenced by the supplied log, preventing a transient taskbar AppWindow failure from closing the overlay through fatal initialization. PR 48683 then retired that legacy window pair in favor of OverlayWindow. The separate later Windows 10 opaque-overlay symptom is covered by PR 50094. design.root_cause: A legacy MainWindow positioning/navigation race could dereference a transiently unavailable TaskbarWindow AppWindow while applying height constraints. The resulting NullReferenceException propagated into initialization failure handling and closed the overlay, producing the flash-and-dismiss behavior.

evidence.detail: The supplied v0.100.2 Shortcut Guide log repeatedly reports MainWindow.xaml.cs::SetWindowPosition::286, NullReferenceException, WinUIEx.WindowManager.get_Height, WinUIEx.WindowManager.set_MaxHeight, and ShortcutGuide.MainWindow.SetWindowPosition.
PR 48481 documents and fixes that same legacy reentrant TaskbarWindow activation and SetWindowPosition failure path, including its initialization-failure close behavior.
PR 48683 replaced the legacy MainWindow and TaskbarWindow pair with OverlayWindow; the current host positions itself through OverlayWindow.RepositionToCursorMonitor.
PR 50094 removes the DWM configuration that broke the transparent overlay on Windows 10, matching the later opaque-background report only.
The original dismissal was caused by the legacy positioning race because its captured stack and the historic remediation's documented failure propagation coincide.

implementation_steps.current_and_new_flow: PR 48481 changed the historical flow so unavailable TaskbarWindow state and positioning exceptions no longer reach initialization failure handling that closes the overlay; it preserves the existing layout and logs the failure instead.
implementation_steps.key_code_shape: if (App.TaskBarWindow?.AppWindow is unavailable) skip the overlap adjustment; catch and log position/navigation failures rather than allowing them to close initialization.
implementation_steps.edge_error_state_handling: The historical fix protects the reentrant activation window and preserves the previous layout on positioning failure.
implementation_steps.tests: The historical PR used a synthetic SetWindowPosition exception repro because the timing race was not deterministic in CI.

implementation_steps.current_and_new_flow: PR 48683 retired the dual legacy windows and now repositions one OverlayWindow against the cursor monitor's work area.
implementation_steps.edge_error_state_handling: The current host returns safely when cursor, monitor, or monitor-info lookup is unavailable and restores temporary size constraints in finally.
implementation_steps.tests: Manual current-release reproduction is required if a new report identifies an OverlayWindow-specific failure.

implementation_steps.current_and_new_flow: PR 50094 removed full-bleed DWM non-client-rendering hardening so the existing transparent backdrop remains active on Windows 10.
implementation_steps.key_code_shape: Keep baseline transparent chrome; do not disable DWM non-client rendering.
implementation_steps.edge_error_state_handling: This correction is scoped to transparent composition and must not be represented as a null-reference remedy.
implementation_steps.tests: Verify transparent rendering manually on Windows 10; no automated DWM composition test exists.
